seams.title: Add soulbond: pairing two creatures
seams.clause: Soulbond (You may pair this creature with another unpaired creature when either enters. They remain paired for as long as you control both of them.) / As long as <this> is paired with another creature, each of those creatures has "..."
seams.why: No pairing state exists. Needs (CR 702.95a-e): a paired-with link on game.Card (additive snapshot field), the two triggers (this enters; another creature enters while this is unpaired) with an intervening 'both unpaired' check and a may-pair choice at resolution, unpairing when either changes controller, stops being a creature or leaves the battlefield, a 'paired' predicate for the conditional layer-6 grant to both creatures (ADR 0093 GrantAbilities), and a protocol/client field so the table shows the pair. Expect game.Card + a new game/soulbond.go, protocol/view.go, effects/soulbond.go, and a client chip.
seams.checked: grep -rni 'soulbond' server/internal docs client/src: 0 hits. grep -rniE 'PairedWith|paired with another' game protocol client/src: 0 hits. grep -il 'paired' cards/effects: 11 files, all unrelated prose (activated.go, ashnods_altar.go ...).

seams.title: Make exploiting an event other permanents can watch
seams.clause: Whenever a creature you control exploits a nontoken creature, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
seams.why: Exploit is modelled in cards/effects/exploit.go as a reflexive trigger private to the exploiting card (exploitSacrificed -> ReflexiveTrigger); nothing is published, so Skull Skaab cannot see another creature's exploit, or tell that the sacrificed creature was a nontoken. Needs an event (exploiter, sacrificed object with last-known information) raised when the sacrifice settles, in game's event kinds and Exploit's keyed run. The other seven exploit cards use the existing Exploit(cardName, payoff) as is and ride with this item because they share the helper.
seams.checked: grep -rl 'Exploit' server/internal/game: 0 files. grep -rnE 'EventExploit|Exploited' game: 0 hits. grep 'exploits a' cards/effects: only exploit.go and its test. Exploit users on develop: overcharged_amalgam.go.

seams.title: Return a card transformed, attached to a named host
seams.clause: When enchanted creature dies, return this card to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target opponent.
seams.why: game.ReturnFromGraveyardTransformedForEffect(cardID, controller, tapped, counters) (game/transform.go:565) has no host parameter. Without one the CR 303.4f entry choice (game/aura_host.go) asks the controller to pick any player for the back face's 'Enchant player', which is untargeted and lets the Curse go on yourself: stronger and different from printed. Needs an AttachedTo (a TargetRef of kind player) on the transformed-return path, as ZoneEntryOptions.AttachedTo / ReturnFromGraveyardTogether.AttachedTo already give the untransformed paths, and CR 303.4i when the host is illegal.
seams.checked: grep -n 'AttachedTo' game/transform.go game/exile_return_transformed_counter.go: 0 hits. grep -liE 'attached to target opponent|transformed under your control attached' cards/effects: 0 files. docs/adding-cards.md 'Auras put onto the battlefield without being cast (#3158)' lists AttachedTo only on SearchLibrary, ReturnFromGraveyardTogether, PutOntoBattlefieldTogetherKeyedForEffect and TokenEntryOptions.
